    • Method Detail

      • FIFO

        public void FIFO()
        Construct a FIFO block. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - address data 8 16 (256 deep x 16 bits) 9 8 (512 deep x 8 bits) 10 4 (1024 deep x 4 bits) 11 2 (2048 deep x 2 bits) 12 1 (4096 deep x 1 bit)

      • FIFO16

        private void FIFO16()
        Construct a FIFO16 for Virtex4. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - address data 9 36 (512 deep x 36 bits) 10 18 (1024 deep x 18 bits) 11 9 (2048 deep x 9 bits) 12 4 (4096 deep x 4 bit)

      • FIFO36

        private void FIFO36()
        Construct a FIFO18 or FIFO_36 for Virtex5, Virtex6 or series 7 or a FIFO18_36 or FIFO36_72 for Virtex5. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - address data 9 36 (512 deep x 36 bits) 10 18 (1024 deep x 18 bits) 11 9 (2048 deep x 9 bits) 12 4 (4096 deep x 4 bit)

      • FIFO72

        private void FIFO72()
        Construct a FIFO36 or FIFO36_72 for Virtex5. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - address data 9 72 (512 deep x 72 bits) 10 36 (1024 deep x 36 bits) 11 18 (2048 deep x 18 bits) 12 9 (4096 deep x 9 bit) 13 4 (4096 deep x 4 bit)
